mapper.sql: id, record_no, car_plate, car_type, space_no, park_type, entry_time, exit_time, duration, fee, paid_fee, pay_status, pay_method, pay_time, gate, operator, remark

where.if: AND (car_plate LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR record_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR gate LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%'))

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO temp_parking (record_no, car_plate, car_type, space_no, park_type, entry_time, exit_time, duration, fee, paid_fee, pay_status, pay_method, pay_time, gate, operator, remark) VALUES (#{recordNo}, #{carPlate}, IFNULL(#{carType}, '小型车'), #{spaceNo}, IFNULL(#{parkType}, 'OUTSIDE'), IFNULL(#{entryTime}, NOW()), #{exitTime}, IFNULL(#{duration}, 0), IFNULL(#{fee}, 0), IFNULL(#{paidFee}, 0), IFNULL(#{payStatus}, 'UNPAID'), #{payMethod}, #{payTime}, #{gate}, #{operator}, #{remark})
mapper.select: SELECT park_type AS name, COUNT(*) AS value, IFNULL(SUM(fee), 0) AS fee, IFNULL(SUM(paid_fee), 0) AS paidFee FROM temp_parking GROUP BY park_type
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(paid_fee), 0) FROM temp_parking WHERE DATE(entry_time) = CURDATE()
SELECT FROM temp_parking WHERE car_plate = #{carPlate} AND exit_time IS NULL ORDER BY entry_time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM temp_parking WHERE exit_time IS NULL ORDER BY entry_time DESC
